units.source_text: 这时，篱笆外面传来卖金鱼的吆喝声，此外没有任何声响。

en.t: Just then, from beyond the hedge came the cry of a goldfish seller, and apart from that there was no sound at all.

units.source_text: 从大街深深拐进二百米的这条小巷里格外清静，

en.t: This little lane, turning deep off the main street for about two hundred meters, was exceptionally quiet,

units.source_text: 房间里也像平时那样静悄悄的。

en.t: and inside the house it was as hushed as usual.

units.source_text: 我知道夫人就在隔壁房间，也知道她正默默地做着针线活儿什么的，能够听见我说话的声音。

en.t: I knew that Sensei's wife was in the next room, and I also knew that, quietly sewing or doing something of the kind, she could hear my voice as I spoke.

units.source_text: 但是我完全忘记了这一点，竟然问先生：

en.t: But I forgot this completely and ended up asking Sensei:

units.source_text: “那么连夫人也不能相信吗？”

en.t: "Then can you not even trust your wife?"

units.source_text: 先生神色有些不安，没有直接回答我的问题：

en.t: Sensei looked somewhat uneasy and did not answer my question directly:

units.source_text: “我连自己都不信任，也就是说自己无法相信自己，所以也就变得无法相信别人了。

en.t: "I do not even trust myself. In other words, because I cannot trust myself, I have become unable to trust other people.

units.source_text: 除了诅咒自己，我没有别的方法。”

en.t: I have no choice but to curse myself."

units.source_text: “如果想得那么复杂，那就没有人是靠得住的了。”

en.t: "If you think about it in such a complicated way, then no one can be relied on."

units.source_text: “不，不是想，而是实际做了。

en.t: "No, it was not something I thought. It was something I actually did.

units.source_text: 做了之后，我很吃惊，而且觉得很可怕。”

en.t: After I did it, I was shocked, and I found it terribly frightening."

units.source_text: 我正想顺着这个话题再问下去，这时听到夫人在隔扇后面叫“先生，先生”。

en.t: I was just about to pursue the subject further when I heard his wife behind the sliding screen calling, "Sensei, Sensei."

units.source_text: 叫到第二声时，先生问：“什么事？”

en.t: When she called a second time, Sensei asked, "What is it?"

units.source_text: “你来一下。”夫人把先生叫到隔壁去了。

en.t: "Come here a moment." His wife called Sensei into the next room.

units.source_text: 我不知道他们之间有什么事，我还没来得及多想，先生就很快回到了客厅。

en.t: I did not know what had happened between them, and before I had time to think much about it, Sensei quickly returned to the sitting room.

units.source_text: “总之，不要太相信我噢。

en.t: "In any case, do not trust me too much.

units.source_text: 太相信的话，迟早会后悔的。

en.t: If you trust me too much, sooner or later you will regret it.

units.source_text: 而且由于自己受到欺骗，最终会导致残酷的报复。”

en.t: And because you yourself have been deceived, it will end in cruel revenge."

units.source_text: “您这话是什么意思呀？”

en.t: "What do you mean by that?"
